description: Judge one whole conversation again now (Score now in the app): a test conversation with its run, a live one as the idle sweep would, whatever the live data settings say. The new verdict replaces the old one and its problems are sorted straight away. Nothing is sent to the agent. A conversation of a run still working is refused until the run is done. Read the result with get_conversation after a minute.

conversation.description: The conversation's id, as get_run lists it under 'conversation_list' or list_problems under 'conversation'.
conversation.title: Conversation

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project
